title: Remove pathlib churn from the scan hot path
weakness: The scan walks and stats every file for every query, using pathlib and re-splitting lines; profiling shows 81% of time in _scan.
hypothesis: String paths, lstat, and cached split lines should cut warm latency by at least 20% with identical results.
risk: Incorrect cache invalidation could return stale results; guarded by full-walk fallback on any stat mismatch and frozen correctness hashes.
